Name: Ravenna Home Larry Contemporary Ottoman, 33.46"W, Light Blue
Colors: Light Blue

Sturdy wooden frame and legs; durable performance polyester fabric; generously padded top Ideal for putting up your feet or serving snacks at your next party A modern update to the classic tufted round ottoman Less than 15-30 minutes assembly required 1-year warranty. 33.46"L x 33.46"W x 18.89"H
